final: WITH g AS (SELECT c.gender AS gender, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS cnt FROM Invoices i JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_cnt FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.cnt * 1.0) AS avg_invoiced_orders_above_avg, AVG(g.cnt - a.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess_over_overall_avg FROM g, a WHERE g.cnt > a.avg_cnt
